verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms documents holding funds in balance accounts, splitting payments, and controlling payout timing via managed or custom payouts, plus chargeback/dispute handling that can delay release (docs-2, docs-3, docs-9, docs-11, docs-24). However, there's no explicit 'escrow' terminology or documented limits (max hold duration, dispute window timing rules, etc.) — the mechanics are inferred from payout/split/chargeback docs rather than a dedicated escrow feature spec. Missing for 10: explicit escrow/hold-until-delivery framing, documented time limits or constraints on how long funds can be held, and independent corroboration of this exact use case.
